text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess crosses the finish line!
Kawakami Princess takes first place!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(I can't catch my breath... I just want to collapse right now...
The sky feels so distant... and my legs are completely dead...)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I love moving my body after all...
Besides, right now is when I'm happiest...)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (Right now feels like when I'm most myself...!)

text_block_list.name: Braided Girl
text_block_list.text:
Big si~s, you were so...
so, so cool!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
! Fufufu, yes.
After all, I am a princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Only victory befits the heroine of a story!
And today, the heroine is ME!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Now, everyone, burn this into your memories!
(Hup!)

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Kawakami Princess-san!?
Climbing on the fence...?"
Before anyone could stop her, Kawakami Princess jumped onto the fence and raised both fists with sheer determination.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Please keep cheering for me!
I'll rake in a massive haul at the next Shuka Sho too!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Ohohoho!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Oooh, this must be her territory...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Haha, way to go, Princess!
As expected of the star of the show today!
I quickly helped her down from the fence, careful not to let her get hurt while she continued her triumphant laughter...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-I am terribly sorry.
My old blood just started boiling...
(Knock knock knock)

text_block_list.name: TV Station Employee
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, thank you for your hard work today.
I'm with "Umamusume Racing for Everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ah, are you the one who made that special video by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Smashing through every door and wall in her way!
The princess enters the frayyy!!" ...part!

text_block_list.name: TV Station Employee
text_block_list.text: Yes, exactly, and on that note...

text_block_list.name: TV Station Employee
text_block_list.text:
"Would you be interested in collaborating with our show next time?
We really want to feature Kawakami Princess-san for the Shuka Sho too!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my. Next time, I would love a stage performance
like 'Purify☆'s [Stars]'!
choice_data_list: We'll consider it, so please feel free to contact us again...

text_block_list.name: TV Station Employee
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, thank you very much.
I'll be in your care!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Aaalrighty, leave it to me!
Ho-ho-ho-ho!!

After that, I reminded Kawakami Princess—whose mind
was completely filled with TV talk—not to do anything dangerous
before heading outside.
choice_data_list: …Let's grab an energy drink while we're at it.

text_block_list.text:
Having taken 1st place, Kawakami Princess
would now take on the vital role of center.

On top of the race fatigue, she must be nervous too.
I'll buy some of her favorite sweets to bring along.

I recognized her face.
If I recall correctly, she attended the press conference for the Oaks...

text_block_list.name: Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry... Even though you went out of your way to cheer for me...!

text_block_list.name: Chestnut Umamusume's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please don't apologize! I truly believed
that you were the one worthy of being the Queen of the Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Chestnut Umamusume's Fan
text_block_list.text: I will definitely, absolutely win the next Shuka Sho. So please, please... don't cry...!

text_block_list.name: Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, yes...!
Next time, I will definitely win... hk.
I'll show you that I can be the star of the Shuka Sho...!

There are plenty of other Umamusume besides Kawakami Princess
who are betting everything on this Tiara path.

Amidst all that, on the glorious stage of the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks)...
...Kawakami Princess claimed 1st place in dazzling fashion.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Welcome back!
What is in that bag in your hand...?
choice_data_list: This is a little gift for you.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, thank you so much!
I was just craving a whole bunch of sweets to fill up on!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, Trainer-san.
I'll give it my all in the live performance too!
choice_data_list: ...Ah, go shine with all you've got.
...Yeah, go out there and shine with all you've got.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

And the Tiara route's live performance,
where only victorious Umamusume can singâ
"—I watched over Kawakami Princess as she sang 'Aya Phantasia.'"

Our next target is the final race of the Tiara line.
...The Shuka Sho.
